Run this notebook to compare the saved dog table with the city licenses and the SSA name reference.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
expected_missing_name_labels <- c(
  "UNKNOWN", "NAME NOT PROVIDED", "NONE", "NA", ".", "NONAME"
)
```

## Read the saved files
```{r}
#| label: read-the-saved-files
source_licenses <- read_csv(
  "data/raw/nyc-dogs-2024.csv",
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
  na = character(), trim_ws = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(source_row_id = row_number()) |>
  rename(zipcode_source = zipcode)


dog_handoff <- read_csv(
  "data/derived/dogs_2024.csv", na = "",
  col_types = cols(
    birth_year = col_character(),
    zipcode = col_character(),
    license_issue_date = col_date(),
    license_expiry_date = col_date(),
    .default = col_guess()
  )
)

license_audit <- read_csv("data/derived/license_to_dog.csv", na = "", show_col_types = FALSE)
ssa_reference <- read_csv("data/derived/ssa_name_reference.csv", na = "", show_col_types = FALSE)
ssa_decades <- read_csv("data/derived/ssa_name_decades.csv", na = "", show_col_types = FALSE)
missing_by_zip <- read_csv(
  "data/derived/missing_names_by_zip.csv", na = "",
  col_types = cols(zipcode = col_character(), .default = col_guess())
)
income_dogs <- read_csv(
  "data/derived/dogs_income_2024.csv", na = "",
  col_types = cols(birth_year = col_character(), zipcode = col_character(), zcta = col_character(), .default = col_guess())
)
income_exclusions <- read_csv(
  "data/derived/income_exclusions.csv", na = "",
  col_types = cols(zipcode = col_character(), zcta = col_character(), .default = col_guess())
)
income_comparison_counts <- read_csv("data/derived/income_comparison_counts.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
zip_income <- read_csv(
  "data/lookups/zip_zcta_income_ny_acs2024.csv", na = "",
  col_types = cols(zip_code = col_character(), zcta = col_character(), .default = col_guess())
)
nyc_areas <- read_csv("data/raw/nyc-zcta-list.csv", col_types = cols(zcta5 = col_character()))
```

## Prepare the identity lookup
Give each lookup a name so its columns and row unit can be inspected before joining.

```{r}
#| label: prepare-the-identity-lookup
dog_handoff |>
  select(
    estimated_dog_id, name, sex, birth_year, breed, zipcode,
    license_issue_date, license_expiry_date
  ) ->
  dog_identity_lookup
```

## Compare source and saved identities
Trace every source license to its representative and compare the five identifying fields, allowing the explicitly approved birth-year inferences. State the expected replacements here independently of the preparation lookup.

```{r}
#| label: compare-source-and-saved-identities
source_licenses |>
  left_join(license_audit, by = "source_row_id", relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  left_join(
    dog_identity_lookup,
    by = "estimated_dog_id", relationship = "many-to-one", na_matches = "never"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    source_name_missing = is.element(animalname, expected_missing_name_labels),
    normalized_source_name = str_to_upper(animalname, locale = "en"),
    normalized_source_zip = str_pad(zipcode_source, width = 5, pad = "0"),
    source_issue_date = str_sub(licenseissueddate, 1, 10),
    source_expiry_date = str_sub(licenseexpireddate, 1, 10)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    normalized_source_name = str_remove_all(normalized_source_name, "[\\s-]"),
    source_issue_date = as.Date(source_issue_date),
    source_expiry_date = as.Date(source_expiry_date)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    expected_birth_year = case_when(
      source_row_id == 61720 ~ "2023",
      source_row_id == 62878 ~ "2022",
      source_row_id == 63559 ~ "2020",
      source_row_id == 99337 ~ "2024",
      source_row_id == 101787 ~ "2022",
      source_row_id == 102214 ~ "2022",
      .default = animalbirth
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    expected_birth_year_has_four_digits = str_detect(expected_birth_year, "^[0-9]{4}$"),
    expected_birth_year_number = as.integer(expected_birth_year)
  ) |>
  mutate(expected_birth_year_in_range = between(expected_birth_year_number, 1990, 2024)) |>
  mutate(birth_year_usable = expected_birth_year_has_four_digits & expected_birth_year_in_range) |>
  mutate(expected_birth_year_exclusion = !source_name_missing & !birth_year_usable) |>
  mutate(
    birth_year_exclusion_agrees = (record_status == "excluded_birth_year") == expected_birth_year_exclusion,
    five_fields_agree = name == normalized_source_name & sex == animalgender &
      birth_year == expected_birth_year & breed == breedname & zipcode == normalized_source_zip
  ) ->
  mapped_licenses

mapped_licenses |>
  filter(!source_name_missing) ->
  named_licenses

named_licenses |>
  filter(birth_year_usable) ->
  included_licenses

named_licenses |>
  filter(!birth_year_usable) ->
  excluded_birth_year_licenses

included_licenses |>
  pull(estimated_dog_id) |>
  unique() ->
  expected_dog_ids

excluded_birth_year_licenses |>
  distinct(estimated_dog_id) |>
  nrow() ->
  excluded_birth_year_dog_count

mapped_licenses |>
  filter(source_name_missing) ->
  missing_licenses

mapped_licenses |>
  filter(record_status == "retained") ->
  retained_licenses
```

## Check representative selection and group sizes
No source license should outrank its retained representative under the documented tie rule.

```{r}
#| label: check-representative-selection-and-group-sizes
included_licenses |>
  mutate(
    later_issue = source_issue_date > license_issue_date,
    same_issue = source_issue_date == license_issue_date,
    later_expiry = source_expiry_date > license_expiry_date,
    same_expiry = source_expiry_date == license_expiry_date,
    earlier_source_row = source_row_id < retained_source_row_id,
    outranks_retained = later_issue | (same_issue & later_expiry) |
      (same_issue & same_expiry & earlier_source_row)
  ) ->
  license_selection

dog_handoff |>
  select(estimated_dog_id, license_record_count) ->
  dog_group_sizes

license_audit |>
  filter(is.element(record_status, c("retained", "consolidated"))) |>
  count(estimated_dog_id, name = "actual_license_count") |>
  left_join(dog_group_sizes, by = "estimated_dog_id", relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  mutate(counts_agree = actual_license_count == license_record_count) ->
  group_counts
```

## Compare saved name flags
Compare the saved dog flags with the independently imported reference.

```{r}
#| label: compare-saved-name-flags
ssa_reference |>
  select(name, ssa_recognized, starts_with("top100_")) ->
  reference_flags

reference_flags |>
  select(-name) |>
  names() ->
  flag_names

dog_handoff |>
  select(estimated_dog_id, all_of(flag_names)) ->
  saved_name_flags

dog_handoff |>
  select(estimated_dog_id, name) |>
  left_join(reference_flags, by = "name", relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  mutate(across(all_of(flag_names), function(name_matches) replace_na(name_matches, FALSE))) |>
  select(-name) ->
  expected_name_flags

saved_name_flags |>
  anti_join(expected_name_flags, by = c("estimated_dog_id", flag_names)) |>
  nrow() ->
  mismatched_flag_rows

ssa_decades |>
  filter(top100) |>
  count(decade, name = "name_count") ->
  top100_counts

included_licenses |>
  filter(animalname == "BABY") ->
  baby_licenses

included_licenses |>
  filter(breedname == "Unknown") ->
  unknown_breed_licenses

```

## Check the NYC income selection
Derive eligible IDs from the saved source lookup and city list. Compare the selected table and exclusion report with the full dog/name handoff.
```{r}
#| label: check-income-selection
dog_handoff |>
  left_join(zip_income, by = c("zipcode" = "zip_code"), relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  filter(is.element(zcta, nyc_areas$zcta5)) |>
  filter(is.element(income_status, c("estimate", "top_coded", "bottom_coded"))) ->
  expected_income_dogs

dog_handoff |>
  anti_join(expected_income_dogs, by = "estimated_dog_id") ->
  expected_income_exclusions

dog_handoff |>
  names() ->
  handoff_fields

income_dogs |>
  select(all_of(handoff_fields)) |>
  anti_join(dog_handoff, by = handoff_fields) |>
  nrow() ->
  altered_dog_rows

expected_income_dogs |>
  filter(income_status == "top_coded") |>
  pull(estimated_dog_id) ->
  expected_capped_dog_ids

income_dogs |>
  filter(income_status == "top_coded") ->
  capped_income_dogs

income_exclusions |>
  count(income_comparison_status = exclusion_reason, name = "estimated_dogs") |>
  add_row(income_comparison_status = "included", estimated_dogs = nrow(income_dogs)) ->
  expected_income_counts
```

## Count records in the saved tables
```{r}
#| label: reconcile-stage-counts
stage_counts <- tribble(
  ~stage, ~count,
  "source_license_records", nrow(source_licenses),
  "missing_name_records", nrow(missing_licenses),
  "named_license_records", nrow(named_licenses),
  "included_license_records", nrow(included_licenses),
  "excluded_birth_year_license_records", nrow(excluded_birth_year_licenses),
  "excluded_birth_year_dogs", excluded_birth_year_dog_count,
  "dogs_after_ssa_join", nrow(dog_handoff),
  "dogs_for_income_comparison", nrow(income_dogs),
  "dogs_excluded_from_income_comparison", nrow(income_exclusions),
  "income_comparison_license_records", sum(income_dogs$license_record_count),
  "income_comparison_top_coded_dogs", nrow(capped_income_dogs),
  "consolidated_license_records", nrow(included_licenses) - nrow(dog_handoff),
  "license_audit_rows", nrow(license_audit),
  "ssa_name_decade_rows", nrow(ssa_decades),
  "ssa_reference_names", nrow(ssa_reference),
  "baby_source_records", sum(named_licenses$animalname == "BABY"),
  "baby_estimated_dogs", sum(retained_licenses$animalname == "BABY")
)
dog_handoff |>
  summarise(across(all_of(flag_names), sum)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "stage", values_to = "count") |>
  mutate(stage = str_c(stage, "_dogs")) ->
  name_match_counts

stage_counts |>
  bind_rows(name_match_counts) ->
  stage_counts

write_csv(stage_counts, "data/derived/stage_counts.csv")
```

## Run the saved-file checks
Each row gives a check and its result.

```{r}
#| label: run-the-saved-file-checks
checks <- tribble(
  ~check, ~passed,
  "105974 source rows",
  nrow(source_licenses) == 105974,
  "audit covers every source row exactly once",
  nrow(license_audit) == nrow(source_licenses) &&
    setequal(license_audit$source_row_id, source_licenses$source_row_id) &&
    !anyDuplicated(license_audit$source_row_id),
  "dog IDs unique",
  !anyDuplicated(dog_handoff$estimated_dog_id),
  "five-field dog keys unique",
  !anyDuplicated(dog_handoff[c("name", "sex", "birth_year", "breed", "zipcode")]),
  "source names classified before normalization",
  all(is.na(mapped_licenses$estimated_dog_id) == mapped_licenses$source_name_missing),
  "5810 missing-name records excluded only from name analysis",
  nrow(missing_licenses) == 5810 && all(missing_licenses$record_status == "missing_name"),
  "all named rows assigned",
  !anyNA(named_licenses$estimated_dog_id),
  "audit birth-year exclusions agree with source years and approved corrections",
  all(mapped_licenses$birth_year_exclusion_agrees),
  "dog CSV contains exactly the eligible estimated dogs",
  setequal(expected_dog_ids, dog_handoff$estimated_dog_id),
  "one retained row per estimated dog",
  nrow(retained_licenses) == nrow(dog_handoff) && !anyDuplicated(retained_licenses$estimated_dog_id),
  "retained IDs agree with dog CSV",
  setequal(retained_licenses$source_row_id, dog_handoff$source_row_id),
  "group sizes reconcile",
  all(group_counts$counts_agree) && sum(dog_handoff$license_record_count) == nrow(included_licenses),
  "latest license and deterministic ties",
  !any(license_selection$outranks_retained),
  "all five key fields agree",
  all(included_licenses$five_fields_agree),
  "ZIP codes are five-character text",
  is.character(dog_handoff$zipcode) && all(str_detect(dog_handoff$zipcode, "^[0-9]{5}$")),
  "source missingness reconciles by ZIP",
  sum(missing_by_zip$source_license_records) == nrow(source_licenses) &&
    sum(missing_by_zip$missing_name_records) == nrow(missing_licenses),
  "reference names unique",
  !anyDuplicated(ssa_reference$name),
  "100 names in each selected decade",
  setequal(top100_counts$decade, seq(1880, 2010, by = 10)) && all(top100_counts$name_count == 100),
  "dog/reference flags agree",
  mismatched_flag_rows == 0,
  "unmatched and recognized dogs retained",
  any(dog_handoff$ssa_recognized) && any(!dog_handoff$ssa_recognized) && !anyNA(saved_name_flags),
  "BABY source records retained",
  nrow(baby_licenses) == 120 && !anyNA(baby_licenses$estimated_dog_id),
  "unknown-breed licenses with usable birth years retained",
  all(is.element(unknown_breed_licenses$estimated_dog_id, dog_handoff$estimated_dog_id)),
  "income and city lookups have unique keys",
  !anyDuplicated(zip_income$zip_code) && !anyDuplicated(nyc_areas$zcta5),
  "income table contains exactly the selected NYC-area dogs",
  setequal(income_dogs$estimated_dog_id, expected_income_dogs$estimated_dog_id) &&
    !anyDuplicated(income_dogs$estimated_dog_id),
  "income join preserves all original dog fields and name flags",
  altered_dog_rows == 0,
  "income exclusions account for every remaining dog exactly once",
  setequal(income_exclusions$estimated_dog_id, expected_income_exclusions$estimated_dog_id) &&
    !anyDuplicated(income_exclusions$estimated_dog_id),
  "income summary counts agree with selected and excluded tables",
  setequal(income_comparison_counts, expected_income_counts),
  "capped incomes retained without treating their codes as exact estimates",
  setequal(capped_income_dogs$estimated_dog_id, expected_capped_dog_ids) &&
    all(is.na(capped_income_dogs$median_household_income))
)
write_csv(checks, "data/derived/validation_checks.csv")
print(checks, n = Inf)
checks |>
  pull(passed) |>
  all() -> all_checks_passed
stopifnot(all_checks_passed)
```

## Record runtime versions
Record the R and package versions used for this run.

```{r}
#| label: record-runtime-versions
getRversion() |>
  as.character() ->
  r_version

tibble(package = "R", version = r_version) -> r_runtime
tibble(package = c("tidyverse", "dplyr", "readr", "stringr", "tidyr")) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(version = as.character(packageVersion(package))) |>
  ungroup() ->
  package_versions

r_runtime |>
  bind_rows(package_versions) ->
  runtime
write_csv(runtime, "data/derived/runtime_versions.csv")
```
